name: Applied Materials
description: Applied Materials sells a broad range of chip-making equipment (deposition, etch, ion implantation, inspection and more) to foundries, logic and memory makers. A smaller arm, Applied Global Services, sells spare parts, upgrades and service contracts on the installed base. Two customers made up 19% and 15% of FY2025 revenue. China was about 28% of revenue in the nine months to July 2026.

gics.note: Conventional GICS label (sector and sub-industry) read from Wikipedia, List of S&P 500 companies, on 2026-09-30 (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_S%26P_500_companies). That page gives only sector and sub-industry; industry group and industry are null because no source read states them. Labelled conventional filing only; Mowgli classification is not assigned here.

hq.note: 3050 Bowers Avenue, Santa Clara, CA 95054 (SEC EDGAR business address)

employees.note: Approximately 36,500 regular full-time employees in 25 countries (FY2025 10-K)

businessLines.name: Semiconductor Systems
businessLines.how: One-time sale of each tool to a chip maker, recognized at a point in time; demand follows customers' fab capital spending.
businessLines.description: New equipment for chip fabrication. From Q1 FY2026 it also includes the 200mm equipment business moved from AGS.

businessLines.name: Applied Global Services (AGS)
businessLines.how: Recurring: service agreements recognized over time, plus spares and upgrades sold as tools age; grows with installed base.
businessLines.description: Spare parts, upgrades, service contracts and equipment for the installed base (FY2025 included 200mm equipment; moved to Semiconductor Systems in FY2026).

businessLines.name: Corporate and Other
businessLines.how: Not described in the filings read.
businessLines.description: Revenue and costs not in reportable segments, plus unallocated corporate costs.
